privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: The institute website does not collect visitors’ personal data without their consent and does not share it with third parties.
privacy.analytics: Visit statistics are collected by a self-hosted analytics server running on the institute’s own infrastructure. The data is anonymous: IP addresses are not stored and no cross-site identifiers are used. Collection starts only after explicit consent.
privacy.cookies: Functional storage keeps the selected language and the accessibility settings. These values stay in the browser and never leave the device.
privacy.contact: Questions about data processing can be sent to the institute email address listed in the footer.
